title: GNet: A scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric neurons
abstract: arXiv:2607.10735v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We build GNet, a scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric activation functions. The key computational contribution is to make estimation of GP activations computationally scalable without forming covariance matrices explicitly. We provide theoretical studies comparing function classes with a fixed architecture, and derive predictive risk bounds for GNets. Using essentially the same architecture and optimization settings, GNet shows competitive performance across a diverse range of test problems, including predicting nonlinear functions, nonparametric regression of real-world data, and predicting one-body direct correlation functions with high-dimensional inputs in classical density functional theory. The strong performance of GNet suggests that flexible nonparametric neurons can substantially reduce the number of trainable parameters while remaining computationally scalable.

translated_title: GNet：一种具有非参数神经元的可扩展且灵活的高斯过程网络
translated_abstract: 我们构建了GNet，一种具有非参数激活函数的可扩展且灵活的高斯过程网络。其关键的计算贡献在于，无需显式构造协方差矩阵即可实现高斯过程激活函数的可扩展估计。我们提供了在固定架构下比较函数类别的理论研究，并推导了GNet的预测风险界。在基本相同的架构和优化设置下，GNet在多种测试问题上均展现出有竞争力的性能，包括非线性函数预测、真实世界数据的非参数回归，以及在经典密度泛函理论中对具有高维输入的一体直接关联函数的预测。GNet的优异表现表明，灵活的非参数神经元能够在保持计算可扩展性的同时，大幅减少可训练参数的数量。
tldr: GNet是一种采用非参数激活函数的高斯过程网络，其核心创新在于无需显式构造协方差矩阵即可实现可扩展估计，从而在大幅减少可训练参数数量的同时保持有竞争力的性能。
en_tdlr: GNet is a scalable and flexible Gaussian process network with nonparametric activation functions whose key contribution is enabling scalable estimation of GP activations without explicitly forming covariance matrices, substantially reducing trainable parameters while maintaining competitive performance.
